## AllocateTemporaryCopyOptions.extension property

File name extension for the copy, such as `.pdf`<!-- -->, so apps and tools that go by extension recognize it: a `.` followed by 1 to 16 ASCII letters or digits.

**Signature:**

```typescript
readonly extension?: string;
```
